description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange With Effect From 20.01.2025 to 26.01.2025
reasoning: This gazette contains a Customs Notification that establishes new exchange rates for customs duties and other charges under the Customs Ordinance. It involves regulatory authority exercised by the Director General of Customs to determine and enforce specific rates, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than government personnel, organizational structure, or any other specialized category.
